data.title: Nonthaburi school reopens after deadly shootings
data.description: The Nonthaburi school where ​a student went on a deadly shooting rampage three weeks ago reopened on Tuesday ​amid heightened security, with police deployed and ‌checks performed on bags.

data.title: Cannabis, watersports ban for US sailors visiting Pattaya
data.description: Cannabis and most watersports are on the "banned" list for the thousands of US navy personnel from the carrier group visiting Chon Buri and Pattaya this week.

data.title: Buri Ram prison suspends visits after positive Covid tests
data.description: BURI RAM - Nang Rong Prison has suspended family visits to three of its zones for one month after around 50 inmates tested positive for Covid-19 and several others were found to have scabies.

data.title: Many data centres in Bangkok built without permission, says digital minister
data.description: Many data centres were operating without permission in Bangkok, with authorities investigating fuel stockpiling and possible foreign investment in the facilities, Digital Economy and Society (DES) Minister Chaichanok Chidchob said on Tuesday.

data.title: Fire guts 15 homes in Makkasan community, one dead
data.description: A fire tore through a residential community in Soi Sukhumvit 3, Makkasan sub-district, Ratchathewi district, in the early hours of Tuesday, killing one person and damaging about 15 houses.

data.title: Man dies in fall from escalator at Bangkok shopping centre
data.description: A man believed to be in his 30s died in a fall from a moving escalator at a shopping centre near Asok intersection in Bangkok on Monday night.

data.title: Popular Thi Lo Su waterfall reopens in Tak
data.description: TAK - The magnificent Thi Lo Su waterfall in Umphang district reopened to the public on Tuesday after being closed for two months to allow natural rehabilitation - but only for four-wheel-drive vehicles.

data.title: BJT pick wins Udon Thani by-election
data.description: <p>Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul on Monday thanked voters after Bhumjaithai Party (BJT) candidate Athikan Kaewkhruasri won the Udon Thani Constituency 3 by-election by a wide margin.</p>

data.title: Defence chief in Pattani to hear security concerns
data.description: <p>Pattani: Defence Minister Lt Gen Adul Boonthamcharoen on Monday visited the Internal Security Operations Command Region 4 Forward Command in this southernmost border province to hear directly from personnel on the ground.</p>

data.title: Senate vote clears emergency energy loan
data.description: <p>The Senate on Monday approved the executive decree authorising the Finance Ministry to borrow 400 billion baht to address the energy crisis and finance the country's energy transition, with 135 senators voting in favour, 11 against and 28 abstaining.</p>

data.title: Police told to pay up over false arrest
data.description: <p>The Supreme Court has ordered the Royal Thai Police (RTP) to pay 4.38 million baht in compensation to Ritrong Cheunjit, ending a 17-year legal battle over his wrongful arrest and torture in 2009.</p>

data.title: Major reservoir plan sparks public protest
data.description: <p>Chanthaburi: Residents and civil society networks are preparing to stage a major rally outside the provincial hall on Sept 13 to oppose the Khlong Wang Tanot reservoir project, following the cabinet's approval of a 7.2-billion-baht budget for the scheme.</p>

data.title: 22 reservoirs overflow in heavy rains
data.description: <p>Authorities have warned of heavy to very heavy rain across upper Thailand through tomorrow, raising the risk of flash floods and forest runoff.</p>

data.title: Ukraine wants winter aid as war drags on
data.description: <p>Ukraine has urged Thailand to provide more humanitarian aid ahead of winter, while calling for greater Thai involvement in reconstruction and efforts to return Ukrainian children taken during the war.</p>

data.title: Court tells Sarana to hear verdict
data.description: <p>The Central Administrative Court has summoned Dr Sarana Boonbaichaiyapruck, the chair of the National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC), to hear its ruling on Wednesday on his qualifications.</p>

data.title: Bulbul breeding rules ease
data.description: <p>Natural Resources and Environment Minister Suchart Chomklin has signed a regulation removing the red-whiskered bulbul (nok krong hua juk) from the protected wildlife list.</p>

data.title: Police in Huai Khwang target 'grey capital' gangs
data.description: <p>Huai Khwang police have launched a sweeping crackdown on high-risk entertainment venues, illegal workers and suspected nominee businesses as part of a campaign to restore confidence in the district and combat grey-capital networks.</p>

data.title: Data centre growth sparks health fears
data.description: <p>A rapid expansion of the data centre industry could pose health and environmental risks to nearby communities, an expert has warned.</p>

data.title: Krok E-Dok waterfall shut for two days
data.description: <p>SARABURI: Khao Yai National Park closed Krok E-Dok waterfall in Kaeng Khoi district from Monday to Tuesday after heavy upstream rain caused flash floods and strong currents.</p>

data.title: Psychological support prepared as school resumes classes after shooting incident
data.description: Debsirin Nonthaburi School has prepared to provide psychological support for up to one year after it resumes on-site classes on Tuesday following a tragic shooting incident on Aug 7.

data.title: Southern shortcut bridges get go-ahead
data.description: Plans have been put into motion by the government to build two major bridges in the nation's southern region with an aim to improve transport connectivity, support tourism and stimulate local economic activity.

data.title: Psychological support prepared as Nonthaburi school resumes on-site classes
data.description: Debsirin Nonthaburi School has prepared to provide psychological support for up to one year after it resumes on-site classes on Tuesday following a tragic shooting incident on Aug 7.

data.title: Young activist 'Tawan' sentenced to 2 years' jail for lese majesty
data.description: Twenty-four-year-old activist Tantawan "Tawan" Tuatulanon was on Monday sentenced to two years in prison, without suspension, for lese majesty in her Facebook livestream protesting against police clearing a route for a royal motorcade in 2022.

data.title: Pregnant teacher ends her life after boyfriend denies paternity
data.description: A pregnant teacher has commited suicide in her car, leaving a letter citing heartbreak because her boyfriend refused to acknowledge paternity of their child.

data.title: Leopard cat killed crossing M6 motorway
data.description: NAKHON RATCHASIMA - A leopard cat, a protected wild species, was struck by a car and killed while crossing the M6 motorway in Lam Takhong district, in an incident caught on camera that went viral online.

data.title: Dept sacks 3,868 local officials for cheating in recruitment exam
data.description: The Department of Local Administration terminated the employment of 3,868 officials nationwide on Monday, suspecting them of rigging their recruitment examination results late last year.

data.title: Collapsed floors prevent investigators reaching heart of Khlongthom fire
data.description: Police investigators on Monday could not reach the point of origin amid the debris of the fire that destroyed the Klongthom Centre in Bangkok last week because two upper floors had collapsed on top of it. Arson has still not been ruled out.

data.title: US carrier visit to Thailand's Pattaya lifts hope and sex-tourism risk
data.description: After a long deployment in the Middle East, a US Navy aircraft carrier will dock in Thailand's resort city of Pattaya this week, raising hopes of an economic boost, even as local authorities cracked down on parts of the sex tourism destination.

data.title: Govt identifiies 767 factories operating unlawfully
data.description: The government has identified 767 factories operating illegally nationwide, but mostly in the Eastern Economic Corridor (EEC), with 131 already shutdown.

data.title: Pattaya bar shooting leaves two wounded
data.description: CHON BURI - A late-night dispute between two men in a Pattaya bar escalated into gunfire in the early hours of Monday, leaving both men wounded in the street after three shots were fired.

data.title: Persistent rain closes waterfalls in Saraburi
data.description: SARABURI - Persistent rain has swollen waterways in Saraburi, leading to the closure of two waterfalls, in Kaeng Khoi and Muak Lek districts, affecting several villages, resorts and tourist access.

data.title: Poll backs 3rd phase of subsidy scheme
data.description: Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas has welcomed strong support for the government's "Thais Help Thais Plus" subsidy programme, which was named its top achievement in a Suan Dusit Poll this month.
